name: ComfyUI image generation
summary: Generates a picture from a text description with the Stable Diffusion / SDXL / Flux checkpoint loaded in ComfyUI on this computer.
when_to_use: Someone asks to generate, make, draw, render or create an image, picture, illustration, concept art, wallpaper or photo of something from a description.
when_not_to_use: Editing a picture they attached, questions about images, or anything that wants words back.

negative.description: what to avoid in the picture

steps.description: sampling steps; more is slower and finer

cfg.description: how strictly to follow the words

seed.description: a fixed seed to repeat a result

checkpoint.description: a specific checkpoint file name ComfyUI has
